title: Cozy office character animations
summary: Characters now walk in eight directions with drawn sprite atlases, sit, sleep, and perform workouts with new poses.

sections.heading: New
items: Walk cycles with 8 directional facings using SpriteCast-generated sprite atlases
Sitting and sleeping poses for characters
Squat animation with four depths for workout sequences
Sprite asset generation pipeline with documentation, rigs, design references and helper tools

sections.heading: Improved
items: Characters route around furniture instead of walking through it
Sprite sizing and positioning optimizations for better visual balance
